claim: RBI has announced that all ₹500 notes printed before 2016 will be invalid from 1 December.
review_reason: The verdict is ready to send as an alert, and an alert waits for approval.

best_match.primary_claim: RBI will discontinue ₹500 notes printed before 2016 from December.
best_match.true_version: RBI had announced no such deadline for ₹500 notes.

explanation: The Reserve Bank has not said that ₹500 notes printed before 2016 become invalid on 1 December [E1]. Two newsrooms describe the forward as fake [E2] [E3].
true_version: ₹500 notes already in circulation remain legal tender unless the Reserve Bank says otherwise [E1].
correction_message: This notice is fake. There is no 1 December deadline for ₹500 notes.

evidence.quote: No circular has been issued declaring ₹500 notes printed before 2016 invalid from 1 December.
evidence.passage: RBI & the finance ministry published the notice page. No circular has been issued declaring ₹500 notes printed before 2016 invalid from 1 December.

evidence.quote: The Reserve Bank said the WhatsApp message about old ₹500 notes is fake.
evidence.passage: The Reserve Bank said the WhatsApp message about old ₹500 notes is fake.

evidence.quote: Fact-checkers found no RBI notice setting 1 December as the last day for ₹500 notes printed before 2016.
evidence.passage: Fact-checkers found no RBI notice setting 1 December as the last day for ₹500 notes printed before 2016.

evidence.quote: Readers have been forwarding a message about old ₹500 notes.
